purpose: Controlled vocabulary for route-level technique tags. A technique is the central idea a route relies on, not the topic of the theorem. Assign 1-3 per route, most central first.

techniques.label: Induction
techniques.gloss: Induction on a size, degree, or dimension, including strong and structural induction.

techniques.label: Extremal principle and descent
techniques.gloss: Minimal counterexample, infinite descent, well-ordering, or a maximal or minimal object.

techniques.label: Counting and parity
techniques.gloss: Double counting, classification of elements, inclusion-exclusion, indicator functions, parity.

techniques.label: Bijection
techniques.gloss: An explicit correspondence, code, or reflection between two sets.

techniques.label: Pigeonhole
techniques.gloss: Forcing a repeat by comparing a count with the number of boxes.

techniques.label: Generating functions
techniques.gloss: Encode a sequence as a series or polynomial and manipulate it.

techniques.label: Moebius inversion and arithmetic identities
techniques.gloss: Moebius and binomial inversion, Selberg-type identities among arithmetic functions.

techniques.label: Telescoping sums
techniques.gloss: Write each term as a difference of consecutive values so a sum collapses to its endpoints.

techniques.label: Paths, chains, and flows
techniques.gloss: Alternating or augmenting paths, Kempe chains, network flows.

techniques.label: Invariance under local moves
techniques.gloss: Define an invariant by a local rule and verify it is unchanged under a generating set of moves.

techniques.label: Probabilistic argument
techniques.gloss: Random variables, expectation, variance, or concentration used inside a proof.

techniques.label: Density increment and regularity
techniques.gloss: Find a sub-structure of higher density, or split into structured and pseudorandom parts.

techniques.label: Group actions
techniques.gloss: Orbits, cosets, the class equation, Lagrange's theorem.

techniques.label: Linear algebra
techniques.gloss: Bases, rank, determinants, Gram matrices, kernels and images.

techniques.label: Ideals and modules
techniques.gloss: Ideals, PIDs and UFDs, module classification, representations and their dimensions.

techniques.label: Polynomial methods
techniques.gloss: Root counting, interpolation, factorization, symmetric polynomials, coefficient comparison.

techniques.label: Leading-term reduction
techniques.gloss: Cancel leading terms in a monomial or triangular order until the remainder vanishes.

techniques.label: Generic parameter choice
techniques.gloss: Choose coefficients or a linear change of variables outside a finite bad set.

techniques.label: Fields and Galois theory
techniques.gloss: Field extensions, splitting fields, Galois correspondence.

techniques.label: Explicit construction
techniques.gloss: Exhibit an explicit family of objects, or a parametrization, and verify the property directly.

techniques.label: Euclidean algorithm and gcd
techniques.gloss: Division with remainder, Bezout, divisibility, and unique-factorization or valuation arguments.

techniques.label: Modular arithmetic
techniques.gloss: Residues, congruences, units and inverses modulo n.

techniques.label: Character and Gauss sums
techniques.gloss: Gauss and Jacobi sums, characters of finite fields.

techniques.label: Homology and exact sequences
techniques.gloss: Chain complexes, exact sequences, Mayer-Vietoris, cohomology.

techniques.label: Categorical equivalence
techniques.gloss: Equivalence or duality of categories used to transport a statement.

techniques.label: K-theory and cobordism
techniques.gloss: Encode an analytic object as a K-theory or cobordism class and compare topological indices.

techniques.label: Iteration and fixed points
techniques.gloss: Successive approximation, contraction mappings, or Newton-style iteration.

techniques.label: Completeness and order
techniques.gloss: Least upper bound, nested intervals, bisection, Cauchy sequences, Archimedean and floor arguments.

techniques.label: Compactness
techniques.gloss: Finite subcovers, convergent subsequences, diagonal arguments, finite intersection property.

techniques.label: Baire category
techniques.gloss: A complete metric space is not a countable union of nowhere dense sets.

techniques.label: Rolle and mean value
techniques.gloss: Rolle, mean value and Cauchy mean value arguments.

techniques.label: Integral calculus
techniques.gloss: Fundamental theorem of calculus, Riemann sums, integration by parts, integral estimates.

techniques.label: Series and asymptotics
techniques.gloss: Power series, Taylor expansion, Laplace's method, Euler-Maclaurin, summation.

techniques.label: Measure and approximation
techniques.gloss: Monotone classes, density and completion, mollification, outer measure, tail bounds and continuity of measure.

techniques.label: Measure transport
techniques.gloss: Push one measure to another by an explicit monotone or triangular map and compare Jacobians.

techniques.label: Orthogonal decomposition
techniques.gloss: Split a space as a closed subspace plus its orthogonal complement by projection.

techniques.label: Fourier analysis
techniques.gloss: Fourier series and transforms, Parseval, characteristic functions.

techniques.label: Ergodic correspondence
techniques.gloss: Translate a combinatorial statement about dense sets into recurrence for a measure-preserving system.

techniques.label: Complex analysis
techniques.gloss: Cauchy estimates, Goursat, normal families, the argument principle used analytically.

techniques.label: Maximum principle
techniques.gloss: Maximum modulus, open mapping, or harmonic maximum principle.

techniques.label: PDE and potential theory
techniques.gloss: Harmonic functions, Green operators, elliptic regularity, heat flow.

techniques.label: ODE uniqueness
techniques.gloss: Characterize a function as the unique solution of a differential equation with given data.

techniques.label: Convexity and inequalities
techniques.gloss: Jensen, Young, tangent-line bounds, convex combinations.

techniques.label: Variational extremum
techniques.gloss: Minimize or maximize a quantity: Rayleigh quotient, extremal function, least distance.

techniques.label: Duality and separation
techniques.gloss: Linear-programming duality, convex separation, dual spaces.

techniques.label: Euler products and zeta
techniques.gloss: Euler products, zeta and L-functions, Tauberian arguments.

techniques.label: Dissection and area
techniques.gloss: Cut, rearrange, or compare areas and volumes.

techniques.label: Similarity and trigonometry
techniques.gloss: Similar triangles, ratios, sine and cosine rules.

techniques.label: Coordinates and vectors
techniques.gloss: Analytic geometry, dot products, complex-plane or barycentric calculation.

techniques.label: Lattice points
techniques.gloss: Lattice-point counting, geometry of numbers, Minkowski-style area arguments.

techniques.label: Symmetrization
techniques.gloss: Replace a set or function by a more symmetric one (Steiner, Schwarz) without worsening the quantity.

techniques.label: Dimension lift
techniques.gloss: Realize a planar configuration in a higher-dimensional space so incidences follow from simpler arguments.

techniques.label: Winding number and degree
techniques.gloss: Winding numbers, degree theory, homotopy invariance.

techniques.label: Connectedness and covering spaces
techniques.gloss: Connectedness, covering spaces, fundamental groups, or an auxiliary topology defined to encode a property.

techniques.label: Triangulation and Euler characteristic
techniques.gloss: Decompose into simplices or cells and count.

techniques.label: Local-to-global patching
techniques.gloss: Partitions of unity, Mayer-Vietoris gluing, sheaf-style patching of local results.

techniques.label: Differential forms and curvature
techniques.gloss: Forms, Stokes, de Rham, curvature, connections.

techniques.label: Morse theory
techniques.gloss: Critical points and gradient flows of a function on a manifold.

techniques.label: Diagonalisation
techniques.gloss: Diagonal construction or self-reference against an assumed list.

techniques.label: Choice and maximality
techniques.gloss: Zorn's lemma, ultrafilters, maximal ideals, transfinite extension.

techniques.label: Model construction
techniques.gloss: Henkin terms, tableaux, ultraproducts, syntactic-semantic translation.

modifiers.derivesFromTheorem: The route mainly applies a larger named theorem instead of proving the result directly. Recorded on the route, never a ring vertex. A route may carry it with no technique at all.
